steps.what: List programming activities still open
Assign programming personnel to those activities
Coordinate the activities in a short meeting
Review the work programming personnel finished
Accept the assigned activities

tasks.design: Open programming activities sit on a {PROJECT} board with owner and due date. The computer programmer assigns personnel in a {CALENDAR} meeting or on that board by hand. The board does not score or rank people. Review of finished work stays a conversation. A written assignment is the record, not a model decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assignments lived in mail and memory, so two people could be given the same activity or none.
tasks.enabler_now: The board can show activity id, state and the current owner, which the programmer edits.
tasks.still_hard: Who should do the work, and whether the finished work is good enough, are judgements about people and programs.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer assigns the activities and reviews the result. No score replaces that.

ambition.what: Review unfinished programming activities every week, not only at a monthly meeting

tasks.altitude: The list is visible without chasing mail. The assignment and the review stay with the programmer.

reach.task: Do the activity the programmer assigned
reach.learn: Which activities are assigned, to whom, and which are still open

evidence.claim: Assigning and reviewing programmers in a mid-size firm is a meeting plus a list. The list can be a board. The choice of person cannot be a score.
People decisions in this task stay with the programmer. Model knowledge: a ranked list of staff would be a different design, and this one does not make one.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task is assigning, coordinating and reviewing programming personnel. Doing the assigned programming is their work, not this saving.
Input contract: activity id, program id, state, current owner, due date. Producer is the board, fed by tickets. An activity with no program id can still be assigned by hand.
Use the project board before custom code. The meeting share fits. The board does not score, rank or monitor staff, so it is not a staff-scoring tool.
unknowns: Who may assign when the programmer is absent.
Whether personnel can see each other's activities.
Which activities are too sensitive for a shared board.
research_questions: What share of activities have an owner today?
How often does the weekly review change an assignment?

already_counted.description: Choosing who does the work stays with the programmer
Reviewing finished work stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Keep activity states aligned when a new work type is added

approvals.approved_version: assignment signed for these activity ids

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the board is incomplete, so the programmer still assigns from memory in the meeting. The high case assumes a clean list, but every assignment and every review stays manual. The personnel's programming time is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Draft a programming exercise for the session

loop.input: the programming point and the last exercise
loop.output: an exercise that names that point
loop.check: The exercise names the programming point and no second point
loop.stop: One pass; stop if the point is blank
loop.why_not_simpler: A useful coding exercise is not a fixed worksheet

steps.what: Train subordinates in program coding
Try the coding exercise in the session
Review the coding the subordinates tried
Note which programming point to repeat

tasks.design: The computer programmer names one programming point on a {DOCS} page. A bounded draft prepares an exercise for that point only. Training subordinates in program coding stays an in-person session on the {CALENDAR}. The programmer reviews what they tried and signs a note of what to repeat. The draft is not the lesson.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exercises were rewritten for each session, and the point they were meant to teach was not written down.
tasks.enabler_now: A page can store the programming point and the last exercise version, so a draft can be checked against that point.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching coding to subordinates, and seeing who is stuck, is a conversation in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides the exercise fits the point and leads the session.

ambition.what: Reuse a signed exercise when the same coding point fails twice, instead of writing a new one each time

tasks.altitude: Less rewriting of the same exercise. The session stays in the room, and the programmer can throw the draft out.

reach.task: Try the signed exercise and bring questions
reach.learn: Which programming point this exercise covers and which note says to repeat it

evidence.claim: Training subordinates to code is an in-person session. An exercise can be drafted. The teaching cannot.
Model knowledge: a drafted exercise often uses a toy case that misses the bug the team actually hit, so the programmer still rewrites it.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task is the training session and its exercise. The subordinates' later project work is not this task.
Input contract: programming point, language name, last exercise id, session date. Producer is the computer programmer. If the point is blank, no draft runs.
Use the document page and the calendar before custom code. The high in-person share fits and stays. This design does not score or monitor the subordinates.
unknowns: Whether subordinates may keep the exercise after the session.
Who teaches when the programmer is absent.
Which points already have a signed exercise.
research_questions: What share of sessions repeat a programming point from the last month?
How often is the drafted exercise rejected in the room?

already_counted.description: Programmer rewrites the exercise before the session
The training session stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Retire exercise versions when the programming point changes

approvals.approved_version: training note signed for this programming point

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes each session is a new point with no page, so the draft does not run and the teaching is unchanged. The high case assumes a reused exercise, but the session and the review stay manual. Subordinates' practice time is not the programmer's saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop web sites from a signed brief

steps.what: Send the brief to develop the sites
Draft site pages from the brief fields

loop.output: pages that cite only those ids
loop.check: Every page cites a page id on the brief
loop.stop: One pass; stop if the page list is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: How a page should read is not a fixed block

steps.what: Develop the sites where the draft is wrong
Review the sites against the brief
Run checks for broken links on the sites
Publish the signed sites version by hand

tasks.design: The software developer files a brief on {PROJECT}: page list, audience and the source text in the {CMS}. A bounded draft proposes pages from that brief only. The computer programmer develops the sites where the draft is wrong. A check looks for broken links. The programmer publishes the signed version in the {CMS} by hand. A draft does not publish, and a green link check is not acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Page requests arrived as mail with images attached, so a draft invented navigation the brief never named.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief can list page ids and source links, and the check can compare published links to that list after a person publishes.
tasks.still_hard: What the sites should say, and whether they match the brief, stay with the programmer. Publishing stays a hand act.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer develops the weak pages and is the only one who publishes.

ambition.what: Publish a corrected page in the same week the brief changes, instead of inside a redesign project

tasks.altitude: Less rebuilding of routine pages. The programmer can refuse to publish a draft, including one whose links all resolve.

reach.task: Accept the published sites version or send the brief back
reach.learn: Which pages are signed and which the link check did not cover

evidence.claim: Developing sites in a mid-size firm is a brief, page work and a hand publish. The brief can start a draft. The publish should not.
Digest [S4] says a coding assistant needs a person to review, so drafted pages are not published by themselves.
Digest [S27] says models wrote vulnerable code in 45% of tests, so a green link check is not proof the sites are correct.
Digest [S28] describes a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so nothing in this task publishes or deploys unattended.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends when the programmer has published a signed sites version by hand, or has refused to.
Input contract: site id, page ids, audience, source links, owner. Producer is the software developer. Missing page ids stop the draft.
Use the content system's drafts and its link report before custom code. The meeting prior overstates this task. Time today is on the brief, the pages and the publish.
The link check does not publish and is not acceptance.
unknowns: Who else may publish in the content system.
Which sites have no separate draft space.
Whether a page change needs a second reviewer.
research_questions: What share of briefs list real page ids?
How often does the programmer reject a draft whose links are all valid?

already_counted.description: Programmer reworks weak pages in the draft
Developing the sites stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Update page fields when a new site section is added
Developers repair briefs the draft rejects

approvals.approved_version: sites version signed and published by hand for this brief

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes briefs stay as mail, so the draft does not run and the programmer still develops the sites by hand. The high case assumes a draft and a link report, but development, review and publishing stay manual. A green link check is not counted as acceptance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train users on computer program functions

steps.what: Draft a short guide to program function

loop.output: a guide that cites only those functions
loop.check: Every section names a function on the list
loop.stop: One pass; stop if the list is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: The example a user needs is not a fixed paragraph

steps.what: Train users on the computer programs
Answer users on a program function
Try the function on a sample record
Note which function users still miss

tasks.design: Before a {CALENDAR} session, the computer programmer lists the program functions to cover in {DOCS}. A bounded draft prepares a short guide from that list only. Training users stays in the room. The programmer answers what the guide missed and signs a note of functions users still miss. The guide does not replace the session.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sessions started from memory, so users who missed the room had nothing that named the functions covered.
tasks.enabler_now: The function list can be a page the draft must cite, and the same page can hold the note after the session.
tasks.still_hard: Showing a function to a user, and noticing they are lost, is in-person work.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer leads the session and decides which function still needs another pass.

ambition.what: Users who missed the session can read the signed function note without waiting for the next class

tasks.altitude: The guide saves a little preparation. The training stays with the users in the room.

reach.task: Try one function from the signed note
reach.learn: Which functions were taught and which the programmer marked as still missed

evidence.claim: Training users on a program is a session. A one-page function list can be drafted. The demonstration cannot.
Model knowledge: users stumble on cases the guide never names, so the programmer still answers in the room and writes what was missed.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task is the training session, not the manual-writing task and not a change to the program.
Input contract: program id, function names, session date, audience. Producer is the computer programmer. An empty function list means no draft.
Use the document page and the calendar before custom code. The in-person share fits. The note is not staff monitoring and does not score users.
unknowns: Whether users may forward the note outside the firm.
Who runs the session when the programmer is away.
Which functions have no safe sample record.
research_questions: What share of sessions repeat the same functions?
How often do users still ask after reading the signed note?

already_counted.description: Programmer edits the guide before the session
Training users stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Update the function list when the program changes

approvals.approved_version: function note signed for this session date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes there is no function list, so the draft does not run and the session is unchanged. The high case assumes a short guide, but the training and the answers stay manual. User practice time is not counted as the programmer's saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Assignment and training stay face to face. Less time goes into rebuilding the same exercise or the same site page, and a site is still published by hand.
reach: Programming personnel see the assigned activities and the exercise version.
System users get a short function note before a training session, and the software developer sees the signed sites version.
skills_to_grow: Assign work from an open list without scoring people.
Keep a training exercise tied to one programming point.
Publish a site only from a signed version, by hand.
role.ambitious_version: Site changes and training notes are versioned, and the programmer still meets the people who do the work.
